name: agent-workbench
description: Portable task orchestration, decision stress-testing, and evidence-backed agent loop discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Stress-test plans, route work, discover safe loops
interface.longDescription: Agent Workbench stress-tests decisions before action, coordinates bounded independently verified subagent work, and discovers recurring work that may be suitable for safe agent loops. Deterministic readiness gates produce proposal-only loop contracts that remain inactive until separately authorized by a human.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Workbench to orchestrate this task through bounded subagents.
Use Agent Workbench to route this risky change and require independent verification.
Use Agent Workbench to rigorously stress-test this plan before acting.
